title: Ham and eggs on toast with rhubarb relish

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Butter, onion, rhubarb, sugar, cider vinegar, eggs, bread and cooked ham are all ordinary home ingredients.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday item at any mainstream supermarket.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a small pan, a frying pan and a toaster or grill, and the techniques are simple.

works.reason: Four eggs, four toasts and eight slices of ham feed four, and the relish ratios and simmer time give soft rhubarb that holds its shape.

honest_times.reason: Chopping an onion and the rhubarb, frying eggs and toasting fit in 15 minutes, and the simmering roughly matches the 10 cook minutes.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning, including the ginger and chives, is used in the steps, and nothing unlisted appears.

seasonal_feel.reason: The rhubarb ends up as 'a spoonful of relish' on top of ham and eggs, so on a rhubarb day it is a condiment rather than the point of the dish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are clear, plain British English a beginner could follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: Eggs, ham and wholemeal toast with a fruit relish make a proper, appealing family breakfast.
